findings.evidence: After the `simp only` the goal is `(-1 * Q / g p ℓ) • p + (1 * Q / g p' ℓ) • p' = Q • ((g p' ℓ)⁻¹ • p' - (g p ℓ)⁻¹ • p)`, the shape `module` targets (`mathlib/Mathlib/Tactic/Module.lean:763`, docstring at 736-761). `grep '\bcongr [2-9]' code/EpsilonEridani` returns exactly one hit: this line.
findings.fix: Drop `smul_sub, smul_smul` from the `simp only` and the two rewrites, and close with `module` (or `match_scalars <;> ring`), which proves linear-combination equalities by ring-normalizing each scalar.
findings.issue: `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine` reshapes the goal by hand (`rw [sub_eq_neg_add, ← neg_smul]`) only so that `congr 2 <;> ring` splits it; both rewrites are position-sensitive and `congr 2` depends on the exact term shape the preceding `simp only` leaves.

findings.evidence: Identical lemma lists at Eikonal.lean:83-84 and Eikonal.lean:112-113; `rw [Finset.sum_comm]` at Eikonal.lean:114 carries no comment.
findings.fix: Add `apply_eikonalCurrent_left` (or similar): `g (eikonalCurrent g L ℓ) v = ∑ i, (L i).signedCharge / g (L i).momentum ℓ * g (L i).momentum v`, and derive both theorems from it; then the sum order is fixed by the lemma statement instead of by simp, or document why `sum_comm` is needed.
findings.issue: The step expanding `g (eikonalCurrent g L ℓ) v` into a sum — `simp only [eikonalCurrent, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]` — is repeated verbatim at lines 83-84 and 112-113, so a reusable fact exists only inside two proofs; it also forces the uncommented `rw [Finset.sum_comm]` at line 114, present solely to undo the summation order simp produced.

summary: One proof hand-normalizes a linear combination with two positional rewrites plus `congr 2` where Mathlib's `module` tactic applies directly, and the expansion of `g (eikonalCurrent g L ℓ) v` is duplicated verbatim in two proofs instead of being a reusable lemma, which also forces an unexplained `Finset.sum_comm`.
